Gaussian and binomial mixed models. See [Mixed models](../mixed-models.qmd) for the supported structures and [Model contracts](../reference-models.qmd) for result keys and algorithms.

## Formula models

### `fit_mixed_gaussian()` {#fit_mixed_gaussian}

Gaussian mixed model from an lme4-style formula, like lme4::lmer(): fixed terms as in fit_ols and random bars (x | g), (x || g), (1 | g1) + (1 | g2), (1 | g1:g2), (1 | g1/g2) mapped onto the fit_mixed_gaussian_matrix core. REML by default. Groups and effects follow first appearance after deletion, not lme4's sorted levels; terms keep formula order. Each random term's effects_cond_var holds one k x k conditional covariance per group, as ranef(condVar = TRUE). Formula syntax and R differences: docs/formulas.qmd. Rows with null/NAN in any variable the formula uses are dropped with one E_WARNING (missing 'raise' rejects them); retained_rows/dropped_rows are original positions.

```php
Phit\fit_mixed_gaussian(
    string $formula,
    mixed $data,
    bool $reml = true,
    string $missing = 'drop',
    mixed $weights = NULL,
    ?array $start = NULL,
    int $maxEvaluations = 20000,
    float $tolerance = 1.0E-7,
    string $optimizer = 'bobyqa',
    float $objectiveTolerance = 1.0E-12,
): array
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$formula` | `string` | required | R formula, e.g. 'y ~ log(x) + f * z + offset(log(t))' |
| `$data` | `mixed` | required | Named columns or factor descriptors; objects use toModelData(), else toColumns() |
| `$reml` | `bool` | `true` | true for REML, false for ML |
| `$missing` | `string` | `'drop'` | 'drop' removes rows with null or NAN in any variable the model uses and warns once; 'raise' rejects them |
| `$weights` | `mixed` | `NULL` | Positive prior weights aligned with the original rows, or a column name |
| `$start` | `?array` | `NULL` | Starting relative covariance factors, in the units of the random columns; null starts diagonal factors at one and off-diagonals at zero |
| `$maxEvaluations` | `int` | `20000` | Largest number of optimizer evaluations |
| `$tolerance` | `float` | `1.0E-7` | BOBYQA final trust-region radius, in (0, 0.1] |
| `$optimizer` | `string` | `'bobyqa'` | 'bobyqa' or 'nelder_mead' |
| `$objectiveTolerance` | `float` | `1.0E-12` | Nelder–Mead stopping tolerance: the standard deviation of the simplex objective values |

**Returns**

### `fit_mixed_logistic()` {#fit_mixed_logistic}

Binomial logit random-intercept model from a formula, like lme4::glmer(family = binomial): exactly one (1 | g) term over the fit_mixed_logistic_matrix core (Laplace by default, adaptive quadrature with quadraturePoints > 1). It fits only the binomial family with the logit link, so it takes no family or link. Responses as in fit_generalized_linear. random_effects_cond_var holds each conditional mode's variance, as ranef(condVar = TRUE). Formula syntax and R differences: docs/formulas.qmd. Rows with null/NAN in any variable the formula uses are dropped with one E_WARNING (missing 'raise' rejects them); retained_rows/dropped_rows are original positions.

```php
Phit\fit_mixed_logistic(
    string $formula,
    mixed $data,
    string $missing = 'drop',
    mixed $weights = NULL,
    int $quadraturePoints = 1,
    int $maxEvaluations = 20000,
    float $tolerance = 1.0E-7,
): array
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$formula` | `string` | required | R formula, e.g. 'y ~ log(x) + f * z + offset(log(t))' |
| `$data` | `mixed` | required | Named columns or factor descriptors; objects use toModelData(), else toColumns() |
| `$missing` | `string` | `'drop'` | 'drop' removes rows with null or NAN in any variable the model uses and warns once; 'raise' rejects them |
| `$weights` | `mixed` | `NULL` | Positive prior weights aligned with the original rows, or a column name |
| `$quadraturePoints` | `int` | `1` | 1 for the Laplace approximation, or 2 to 61 for adaptive Gauss–Hermite quadrature |
| `$maxEvaluations` | `int` | `20000` | Largest number of optimizer evaluations |
| `$tolerance` | `float` | `1.0E-7` | BOBYQA final trust-region radius, in (0, 0.1] |

## Matrix models

### `fit_mixed_gaussian_matrix()` {#fit_mixed_gaussian_matrix}

Gaussian mixed model on a numeric design and explicit random terms, like lme4::lmer(). Predictor matrix: rows are observations. A fixed intercept is prepended by default. null/NAN rows follow the missing policy; weights/offset are aligned with original rows.

```php
Phit\fit_mixed_gaussian_matrix(
    array $x,
    array $y,
    array $random,
    string $missing = 'drop',
    bool $reml = false,
    ?array $weights = NULL,
    ?array $offset = NULL,
    ?array $start = NULL,
    int $maxEvaluations = 20000,
    float $tolerance = 1.0E-7,
    string $optimizer = 'bobyqa',
    float $objectiveTolerance = 1.0E-12,
    bool $intercept = true,
): array
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | `array` | required | Predictor matrix: one row per observation and one numeric column per predictor; null or NAN is missing |
| `$y` | `array` | required | Numeric response, one value per row; null or NAN is missing |
| `$random` | `array` | required | Random terms, each an array with 'z' (n × k design), 'groups' (one label per row), and optional 'correlated' (default true; false is (x \|\| g)) |
| `$missing` | `string` | `'drop'` | 'drop' removes rows with null or NAN in any variable the model uses and warns once; 'raise' rejects them |
| `$reml` | `bool` | `false` | true for REML, false for ML |
| `$weights` | `?array` | `NULL` | Positive prior weights aligned with the rows |
| `$offset` | `?array` | `NULL` | Known part of the linear predictor, aligned with the rows; null is zero |
| `$start` | `?array` | `NULL` | Starting relative covariance factors, in the units of the random columns; null starts diagonal factors at one and off-diagonals at zero |
| `$maxEvaluations` | `int` | `20000` | Largest number of optimizer evaluations |
| `$tolerance` | `float` | `1.0E-7` | BOBYQA final trust-region radius, in (0, 0.1] |
| `$optimizer` | `string` | `'bobyqa'` | 'bobyqa' or 'nelder_mead' |
| `$objectiveTolerance` | `float` | `1.0E-12` | Nelder–Mead stopping tolerance: the standard deviation of the simplex objective values |
| `$intercept` | `bool` | `true` | False uses x exactly (including any caller-supplied ones). |

**Returns**


### `fit_mixed_gaussian_intercept_matrix()` {#fit_mixed_gaussian_intercept_matrix}

Gaussian model with one random intercept, fitted by ML on a numeric design. Predictor matrix: rows are observations. A fixed intercept is prepended by default. null/NAN rows follow the missing policy; weights/offset are aligned with original rows.

```php
Phit\fit_mixed_gaussian_intercept_matrix(
    array $x,
    array $y,
    array $groups,
    string $missing = 'drop',
    bool $intercept = true,
): array
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | `array` | required | Predictor matrix: one row per observation and one numeric column per predictor; null or NAN is missing |
| `$y` | `array` | required | Numeric response, one value per row; null or NAN is missing |
| `$groups` | `array` | required | Group label per row, an integer or a string; integer 1 and string "1" are different groups |
| `$missing` | `string` | `'drop'` | 'drop' removes rows with null or NAN in any variable the model uses and warns once; 'raise' rejects them |
| `$intercept` | `bool` | `true` | False uses x exactly (including any caller-supplied ones). |

### `fit_mixed_logistic_matrix()` {#fit_mixed_logistic_matrix}

Binomial logit model with one random intercept on a numeric design, like lme4::glmer(family = binomial). Predictor matrix: rows are observations. A fixed intercept is prepended by default. null/NAN rows follow the missing policy; weights/offset are aligned with original rows.

```php
Phit\fit_mixed_logistic_matrix(
    array $x,
    array $y,
    array $groups,
    string $missing = 'drop',
    ?array $weights = NULL,
    ?array $offset = NULL,
    int $quadraturePoints = 1,
    int $maxEvaluations = 20000,
    float $tolerance = 1.0E-7,
    bool $intercept = true,
): array
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$x` | `array` | required | Predictor matrix: one row per observation and one numeric column per predictor; null or NAN is missing |
| `$y` | `array` | required | 0/1 outcomes, or proportions with integer trial weights; null or NAN is missing |
| `$groups` | `array` | required | Group label per row, an integer or a string; integer 1 and string "1" are different groups |
| `$missing` | `string` | `'drop'` | 'drop' removes rows with null or NAN in any variable the model uses and warns once; 'raise' rejects them |
| `$weights` | `?array` | `NULL` | Positive integer trial counts, at most 1,000,000 per row; null is one trial per row |
| `$offset` | `?array` | `NULL` | Known part of the linear predictor, aligned with the rows; null is zero |
| `$quadraturePoints` | `int` | `1` | 1 for the Laplace approximation, or 2 to 61 for adaptive Gauss–Hermite quadrature |
| `$maxEvaluations` | `int` | `20000` | Largest number of optimizer evaluations |
| `$tolerance` | `float` | `1.0E-7` | BOBYQA final trust-region radius, in (0, 0.1] |
| `$intercept` | `bool` | `true` | False uses x exactly (including any caller-supplied ones). |
